text: Hi, I'm Tia – an AI secretary for small business owners.
Every morning I read every inbox: email, WhatsApp, Instagram and Slack.
Routine work, I finish myself. Anything with money or risk waits for you – like this fake bank-details email.
You stay in the apps you already know. I write the reply from your own business notes – you just check it.
Need a contract? Just ask. If a detail is missing, I ask you first.
Approve it – and it's a PDF, printed, and waiting in Outlook for you to send.
Everything I know comes from your notes, and you can watch exactly what I read.
Book a meeting in one sentence.
I review your real ads – and write better ones.
And you can approve it all from your phone.
I'm Tia. I do the busywork – every decision stays yours.
